about:
Absolute Packaging was established in 2001 in Springfield, Virginia, by packaging professionals focused on delivering responsible packaging development and product-specific packaging to the DC Metropolitan area. The company operates as a B2B support company serving a diverse client base.

The company designs and manufactures protective foam interiors configured for a wide assortment of products using a variety of cushioning materials. Its professional design engineers create packaging "from the inside out" with smart, innovative designs backed by a full line of advanced manufacturing equipment and proprietary systems. Services include custom foam design and fabrication, design and engineering, a customer stock program, custom box design, in-stock packaging, and wood crating and pallets. The firm also provides specialized packaging for art galleries and museums, with engineers holding over 31 combined years of experience in that niche.

Absolute Packaging serves the US Military, federal government agencies, bio-tech firms, electronics manufacturers, educational institutions, transportation companies, wholesalers, manufacturers, distribution companies, and art galleries and museums, including the National Archives. Its customer base spans the DC Metropolitan area and extends to companies across the USA through its design and engineering division.

The company states it is the only custom packaging solutions provider in Northern Virginia. Its designs are engineered to meet International Safe Transit Association (ISTA) drop testing specifications, including ISTA 1-A. A proprietary Customer Stock Program aims to eliminate storage and material delay issues for qualified businesses. Core values of honesty, professionalism, and respect underpin its approach to customer service.
